grade.name: Form 1
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 1" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: HOME TRADE
topics.description: This topic exposes learners to the real world of conducting business within the country. Home trade is trade done within a country and is divided into retail and wholesale trade.

sub_topics.name: RETAIL TRADE
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers what retail trade is, its functions, factors considered before putting up a retail outlet, opportunities and challenges of running a retail business, and how learners can practice running a retail business.

sub_topics.name: WHOLESALE TRADE
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers the definition of wholesale trade, its functions, its opportunities and challenges, and how learners can practice running a wholesale business.

sub_topics.name: DOCUMENTS USED IN HOME TRADE
sub_topics.description: This sub-topic covers the written business documentation involved between buyers and sellers to provide evidence of transactions, protect rights, and ensure legal compliance.

competencies.description: Prepare documents used in home trade

topics.name: CONTRACT
topics.description: Contracts are an important aspect of business, commerce and everyday life because they provide a systematic approach for exchanging goods, services, promises and agreements. A Business Contract is a legally binding exchange of promises or agreements between parties that the law will enforce.

sub_topics.name: BUSINESS CONTRACT
sub_topics.description: A business contract is a legally binding agreement between two or more parties that outlines the terms and conditions for the exchange of goods or services. It is a formal document that turns promises into detailed lists of rights, rules and obligations that both parties must follow.

competencies.description: Exhibit knowledge of a Business Contract

topics.name: ENTREPRENEURSHIP
topics.description: Entrepreneurship is the process of designing, launching and running a new business. It’s the ability and willingness to develop, organize and manage a business along with all the risks involved in order to make profit. It is about identifying or creating business opportunities in the environment through creativity and innovation, solving problems and then converting them into something of value for the people/customers.

sub_topics.name: ENTREPRENEUR
sub_topics.description: Entrepreneurs are essential drivers of economic development, growth, job creation and societal innovation, shaping industries and transforming communities. An entrepreneur is an individual who creates, organizes and manages a business or enterprise with a view or goal of making a profit.
